senses.definition: A prepackaged meal purchased chilled or frozen and heated at home.
senses.example: Like foil-tray frozen meals, which were used by airlines before Swanson branded them as “TV dinners,” Twitter was not initially invented to be an adjunct to the tube.

senses.definition: An early type of video game, the predecessor of modern games consoles, consisting of a unit with a built-in controller that plugged into a television set.
A book, magazine or website that lists the television schedule.
An interactive menu-based system displaying the television schedule on the television screen.
The world as depicted on television.
A movie made for and initially broadcast by a television channel.

The situation where a commercial break during a television programme adversely affects electricity generation and transmission as large numbers of people are operating appliances (kettles, refrigerators, etc.) at the same time.
A room in a domestic space primarily dedicated to watching and using a television.
A stand upon which a television is placed for viewing. The stand can be freestanding or designed to be attached to a wall.
A form of autistic echolalia involving the repetition of words or phrases from television.

A time-out taking place during a televised sports match where the game clock is stopped for a period of time to allow for TV commercials to air before the resumption of play. The delay is usually after a whistle or other stoppage of play occurs, and not an interference with gameplay in and of itself.
A tray on which a meal can be informally served for eating while watching television.
A hardware component that allows a computer to receive television signals.
A kind of video terminal that could be used with a standard television set.
A female character archetype who is married to the main or co-lead male character, traditionally serving as either the grounded voice of reason in a sitcom or a complex partner in a drama.
